Concepts

This case-sensitive code system http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/v3-ManagedParticipationStatus defines the following codes in a Is-A hierarchy:

LvlCodeDefinitionStatus
1normal The 'typical' state. Excludes "nullified" which represents the termination state of a participation instance that was created in error.active
2  active The state representing the fact that the Participation is in progress.active
2  cancelled The terminal state resulting from cancellation of the Participation prior to activation.active
2  completed The terminal state representing the successful completion of the Participation.active
2  pending The state representing that fact that the Participation has not yet become active.active
1nullified The state representing the termination of a Participation instance that was created in error.active
